title: Update pricing experiment flags + cohort tagging in telemetry
author: Caleb Johnson
body:
Context: We have multiple Q1 pricing/packaging experiments running across self-serve and sales-assisted cohorts. Recent meter hardening work surfaced that our current cohort tagging is incomplete/inconsistent across request logs, usage events, and the analytics events used for experiment readouts. This PR standardizes how experiment assignment is computed and ensures the assignment is attached to both (a) usage_events used for billing/finance recon and (b) pricing_analytics events used for conversion/retention analysis. Goal: make experiment analyses reproducible and prevent “meter fixes changed the data” ambiguity by explicitly tagging assignment source and effective timestamps.

What changed (high-level):
- Introduced a unified experiment context object resolved at the API edge (gateway) and propagated to downstream logging/usage events.
- Standardized identifiers:
  - experiment_id: stable string key (e.g., "2026q1_pricing_variant_b")
  - experiment_variant: "control" | "A" | "B" | "C" (string, not boolean)
  - experiment_assignment_source: "flag_service" | "sales_override" | "manual_allowlist" | "unknown"
  - experiment_assignment_ts: RFC3339 timestamp when assignment was computed (edge time)
- Added cohort dimensions required by Product Ops + FP&A:
  - customer_segment: "self_serve" | "sales_led" (derived from account metadata snapshot)
  - plan_at_request: plan code at request time (best-effort; may be null for unauthenticated)
  - is_eligible: whether request met experiment eligibility criteria (prevents accidental inclusion)
- Emitted a new analytics event pricing_experiment_exposure_v2 (fire once per account+experiment per 24h, idempotent key) to avoid per-request inflation in experiment dashboards.
- Added columns to usage_events_v1 and pricing_analytics_events tables (Snowflake) with null-safe defaults for historical data.
- Added validation + PII controls:
  - no prompt text, no user identifiers
  - account_id is already internal; additionally we only log workspace_id and an account_hash in analytics events
- Added unit/integration tests around assignment determinism and propagation.

Why this approach:
- Our previous tagging depended on a mix of client-side flags and server-side lookups; when retries/fallback occurred, some requests would lose tags, biasing variant metrics.
- We need explicit assignment_source to support auditability (Finance/Legal requests) and to debug cohort contamination.
- Exposure event de-duplicates the “who was in which variant” question from raw request volume.

Implementation details:
- Gateway resolves experiment assignment using Flag Service + overrides:
  1) sales_override (explicit CRM/RevOps set) wins
  2) manual_allowlist (support escalations / controlled rollouts)
  3) flag_service evaluation
- Propagation path:
  - request_context -> request_log -> usage_event_builder -> usage_events_v1
  - request_context -> analytics_event_emitter -> pricing_experiment_exposure_v2
- Idempotency:
  - exposure event uses key: sha256(workspace_id + experiment_id + date_utc)
  - usage events rely on existing request_id; we only attach tags, we do not change dedupe semantics

Schema changes:
- usage_events_v1 new nullable columns:
  - experiment_id, experiment_variant, experiment_assignment_source, experiment_assignment_ts, is_experiment_eligible, customer_segment, plan_at_request
- pricing_analytics_events new event type:
  - pricing_experiment_exposure_v2 with the same fields (plus account_hash)

Rollout plan:
- Behind feature flag: telemetry.experiments_context_v2
- Stage 1: enable in staging + perf-canary
- Stage 2: 1% prod (self-serve only) for 24h; monitor null-rate, variant distribution skew, and event volume
- Stage 3: 25% -> 100% with RevOps confirmation that sales_override path works
- Monitoring: dashboards to be updated separately (see follow-ups); for now we emit metrics:
  - exp_context_attached_rate
  - exposure_event_emit_rate
  - exposure_event_dedupe_rate

Test plan:
- Unit:
  - deterministic variant assignment given workspace_id + flag seed
  - precedence rules (sales_override > allowlist > flag_service)
- Integration:
  - send chat request with known workspace_id in allowlist; assert usage event includes expected experiment_id/variant
  - retry simulation preserves tags
- Data validation:
  - in staging Snowflake, ensure exposure events count <= active workspaces and null-rate < 0.5%

Notes / caveats:
- This PR does not change billing calculation. It only adds tagging fields used for analysis and reconciliation.
- For experiment readouts, Product Ops should segment by meter_version (pre/post meter-fix window) as discussed in PM-1848; this PR adds experiment_assignment_ts to make that segmentation robust.

Related:
- PRs in-flight: missing region dimension fix, usage API field expansions; this work is compatible and does not assume those fields are present.
- Support context: recent discrepancies and cohort confusion in pricing calls; consistent tagging is required before we publish new guidance.

Follow-ups:
- Update readout queries and dashboards to use exposure event as source-of-truth for assignment.
- Add an alert if eligibility unexpectedly changes for an account mid-day (potential flag drift).
commits: gateway: resolve unified experiment context at edge and attach to request_context
telemetry: extend usage_event_builder to include experiment/cohort dimensions
analytics: add pricing_experiment_exposure_v2 emitter with daily idempotency
data: add Snowflake schema migrations for new columns + backfill-safe defaults
tests: add unit/integration coverage for precedence + propagation
conversation:
Chris Osei (review): Can we ensure experiment_variant is always a string (control/A/B) and not a boolean like some older experiments? Also need a field that tells us whether the account was eligible vs just untagged.

Caleb Johnson (author): Updated: experiment_variant is now an explicit enum string. Added is_experiment_eligible and documented the difference between eligible=false vs null fields (null means older requests or flag disabled).

Nadia Rahman (review): Be careful about emitting per-request analytics events; this can blow up cardinality and cost. Prefer a deduped exposure event and keep per-request tagging in usage_events only.

Caleb Johnson (author): Agreed. Switched to pricing_experiment_exposure_v2 (once per account/experiment/day) with idempotency key; kept per-request fields only in usage_events.

Mei Lin (review): For Finance reconciliation, we need assignment_source and assignment_ts. Also, please confirm we’re not logging any user identifiers.

Caleb Johnson (author): Added experiment_assignment_source + experiment_assignment_ts. Confirmed analytics event uses account_hash only; usage_events are internal and already governed by access controls; no user identifiers/prompt content added.

Logan Wright (review): Potential risk: if assignment is resolved after auth middleware, unauthenticated requests won’t be tagged and could bias free-tier conversion analysis. Is that expected?

Caleb Johnson (author): Expected for unauthenticated traffic; eligibility is defined at workspace/account level. Added plan_at_request best-effort and documented null semantics. For conversion, Product Ops should rely on exposure event which only emits for authenticated workspaces.

Rishi Malhotra (review): Please add a quick note on how to segment pre/post meter fix in analysis.

Caleb Johnson (author): Added note in PR body and ensured assignment_ts is included to support those segments.

Final: All reviewers approved after changes; CI green; merged via squash.
release_notes: Internal-only telemetry: standardizes pricing experiment assignment + cohort tagging and adds a deduped exposure analytics event for reliable experiment readouts.
